summary: TC-LAYOUT describes a browser observation for the AD-2 board composition at mobile and desktop sizes in both themes. TC-BOARD and TC-SUMMARY preserve the node state regression separately. This specification does not report a rendered result.

test_cases.oracle: The existing design record is available as KNOWLEDGE/architecture.md, decision AD-2. Check the summary just after the board, no wider than 32rem and separated by 1rem. Run the seeded focused procedure node ./scripts/check-board-browser.cjs --light-page="#f4f1e9" --dark-page="#17201f" --square-a="#e7dcc5" --square-b="#34746b" --board-max=32rem --focus-color="#214c46" --dark-focus-color="#f3c15b" --dark-class=theme-dark --summary-below --summary-max=32rem --summary-gap=1rem. Observe equal square geometry, both viewport sizes (390x844 and 1440x1000), light/dark themes, focus visibility, no horizontal scroll, and all 64 controls.
test_cases.red: The board or cells are not square, overflow appears, the existing summary is misplaced or exceeds its saved width/gap, focus is not visible, or a square button is absent.
test_cases.green: The browser observations pass at both viewport sizes and themes; retain the per-viewport/theme TC-LAYOUT output lines.

test_cases.oracle: Run node --test test/board-state.test.mjs for existing selection, coordinate-validation, and Reset state checks. TC-LAYOUT separately observes the 64 rendered square buttons; Node state assertions do not establish their appearance.
test_cases.red: Selection, coordinate validation, or Reset state behavior regresses.
test_cases.green: The existing node state checks pass and the browser observation confirms all 64 controls remain present.

test_cases.oracle: Run node --test test/board-state.test.mjs to assert the initial Choose a square prompt, a selected coordinate such as Selected: a1, and Reset restoring Choose a square. TC-LAYOUT also checks the visible status after browser selection and Reset.
test_cases.red: The existing status text or Reset behavior fails, or the rendered status does not announce selection and reset.
test_cases.green: The node state checks and the browser-observed polite status interaction pass.
